zh.title: 英國航空宣佈2026及2027年新增10個航點城市
zh.summary: 英國航空宣佈2026及2027年新增10個城市航點；飛自倫敦3座機場
body: 英國航空（British Airways）宣佈將於2026年及2027年新增10個航點城市，相關消息由媒體報導披露。
根據報導，這10個新航點均從倫敦的三座機場出發，顯示這些航線將由倫敦的機場網絡提供服務。
報導並未逐一列出新增城市的名單，也未說明具體的開航日期、航線或航班編號等細節。
目前資訊屬計劃階段，具體的航點安排和時間表仍有待英國航空方面進一步公佈，旅客或業界仍須等待更完整的官方訊息。

en.title: British Airways Adds 10 New Cities in 2026 & 2027
en.summary: British Airways to add 10 new cities in 2026 and 2027; all from three London airports
body: British Airways is adding 10 new destination cities in 2026 and 2027, according to a report.
The new routes will all depart from three London airports, indicating the services will be spread across these hubs.
The report does not detail which cities are included, nor does it specify launch dates, specific routes, or flight numbers.
As this remains an announced plan, further details would need to be provided by the airline; passengers and industry observers will need to wait for more complete official information.
